name: tributaries
goal: Demonstrate multiple roots and uneven branches before one final join.

argv: from pathlib import Path; assert Path('left.txt').is_file() and Path('right-final.txt').is_file(); p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'join-all\n'); Path('joined.txt').write_text(Path('left.txt').read_text() + ' + ' + Path('right-final.txt').read_text())

from pathlib import Path; p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'right-final\n'); Path('right-final.txt').write_text(Path('right-middle.txt').read_text() + '-final')
from pathlib import Path; p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'independent-leaf\n'); Path('independent.txt').write_text('independent')
from pathlib import Path; p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'left-leaf\n'); Path('left.txt').write_text(Path('left-root.txt').read_text() + '-leaf')

from pathlib import Path; p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'right-middle\n'); Path('right-middle.txt').write_text(Path('right-root.txt').read_text() + '-middle')
from pathlib import Path; p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'left-root\n'); Path('left-root.txt').write_text('left')
from pathlib import Path; p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'right-root\n'); Path('right-root.txt').write_text('right')
